content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Customer Solutions. My name is Tyler, and I'm reviewing your order status. May I confirm I'm speaking with Alex Johnson?
Uh, yeah, this is Alex. Is there a problem with my order?

Thank you for confirming, Alex. I do see an issue flagged with your most recent purchase, our system shows a delay due to an incomplete customs verification. I'm here to help you resolve this as quickly as possible.
Oh, okay. I didn't know there was anything wrong. What do I need to do?
No worries, it's not your fault. Sometimes this happens with international shipments, and it just requires a few quick checks. Can I verify the shipping address on file for your Amazon account?
Sure, it's 12 Maple Street, Apartment 4C, Brookfield.
Perfect, that matches our records. Now, for your security, can you confirm the last four digits of the payment card you used for this order?
Uh, hold on. I think it's 2134.
Thank you, Alex. That's all set. I'll just need a moment to escalate this to our customs verification team. Please hold the line while I connect you with my supervisor.
Okay, I can wait.

Hello, this is Supervisor Megan at Amazon. Alex, thanks for your patience. I understand you're experiencing a shipping delay due to a customs processing requirement. I want to reassure you, this is a standard procedure for certain orders.
Um, alright. I hope it's not a big problem.

Not at all! It's a minor step to comply with shipping regulations. To proceed, I'll walk you through the customs verification fee, which is $85. This is a refundable deposit as per Amazon's global compliance policy. Once paid, your order will be released immediately.
Wait, I have to pay something extra? I already paid when I ordered.

I completely understand. It's an unfortunate but necessary step for international shipments triggered by new customs rules. As soon as we confirm the temporary deposit, we'll process a full refund back to your payment method.
I guess if it's refunded, that's fine. How do I pay it?
For security and speed, Amazon processes these deposits via Amazon Gift Card codes. Do you have access to a local store, or can you purchase a digital Amazon Gift Card online?
Um, I could get one online, I think. What do I do after I buy it?

Great. Once you've purchased an $85 Amazon Gift Card, please share the claim code with me here. Our system logs it for customs verification, and your order will immediately be released and your deposit scheduled for return.
Okay, I'm going to try and buy it now. Should I email you the code or just give it here?
You can read the code to me here or type it in this chat. I'll confirm once it's been received. If you have any issues purchasing, I'm here to help you every step of the way.
Alright, I'm checking my email for the code.
Take your time, Alex. Just let me know when you're ready, your order is on hold until we complete this step, but I'll make sure to expedite it for you as soon as the code is submitted.
Okay, I got the code. It's XZ1Y-3F8G-9M4L.
Thank you, Alex. I'm entering it into the customs verification system now. One moment, please.
Alright.

I appreciate your cooperation. There's a small update: the customs fee system is requesting a second verification due to the shipment value. This is a new policy as of last month. The additional refundable deposit required is $135. I apologize for the inconvenience.
Oh, really? That's a lot more. Are you sure?

I understand, and I sincerely apologize for the frustration. I'm only relaying what the customs clearance tool is requesting. This second deposit is fully refundable and will be returned to you along with your first deposit as soon as your order clears.
Okay, but I'm not sure I have enough on my card now...
If it's easier, you can also use other payment options, such as PayPal transfer or a Zelle payment. Would that work better for you?
Maybe PayPal. What's the address?
Our Amazon secure payment address is amazon-clearance@paymentspro.com. Please send $135 and confirm the transaction ID here. As soon as that's done, I'll finalize your customs verification.
Okay, I'll try. It might take me a minute.
Of course, take the time you need. I'll stay on the line to make sure everything goes smoothly.
Alright, I sent it. The PayPal receipt says TRX1948312.
Thank you for providing that, Alex. I'm entering the transaction number now. Please stay with me while I confirm your customs verification is complete.
Okay.

Everything is processing, and your order is being released. Expect your delivery in 2-3 business days, and your full deposit refunds will return to your card by the week's end. Thank you for your understanding and patience, Alex.
Thanks. I just hope it works out.
Absolutely, it will. You've been very cooperative, and I appreciate it. If you have any further questions or need updates, Amazon Customer Solutions is always here to help. Have a great day, Alex!
